records.name: 왕건
records.design: A founding sovereign, calm broad oval face and rounded black beard, confident compassionate eyes. A tall compact GOLD TONGCHEONGWAN-inspired crown with vertical ribs and small round sun/moon discs along its upper rim, inspired by the posthumous Goryeo Taejo bronze statue; NOT a flat tasselled crown. Deep indigo silk royal robe with restrained gold geometric collar embroidery and ivory inner collar. Upright stately near-frontal shoulders. Crown visibly unlike every military helmet. Historical inspiration, not exact reconstruction.
records.appearance: 금빛 세로 관·남색 예복의 건국 군주
records.referenceNote: 사후 태조 동상의 통천관 추정 형태와 원형 장식을 참고했다. 생전 착용 복식의 복원이 아니며 예복 색·문양·용모는 창작이다.

records.name: 홍유
records.design: Rugged angular face and dense black beard retained. Senior cavalry GENERAL: open-faced dark iron segmented helmet with small red plume, visible ears and cheek silhouette, short lamellar nape guard. Black iron lamellar shoulders with burgundy cords and red cloak edge. Strong authoritative shoulders, red accent. No oversized fantasy horns.
records.appearance: 붉은 술 투구·흑철 군장의 기병 장군
records.referenceNote: 투구와 찰갑이라는 군장 요소를 참고한 창작이다. 홍유 개인의 실제 투구 형태·색상은 확인되지 않았다.

records.name: 유금필
records.design: Rugged tan asymmetrical face, healed cheek scar, broad moustache and confident grin retained. Veteran assault cavalry GENERAL: low bronze-trim iron helmet with broad open brow, dark russet cape, heavy weathered lamellar cuirass visible at shoulders, cream padded collar. Broad muscular neck, scar face clearly visible. Helmet silhouette squat and broad, NOT tall red plume.
records.appearance: 낮은 투구·거친 군장과 망토의 돌격 장군
records.referenceNote: 군장 유형을 참고하되 투구와 흉터·표정은 인물 구분을 위한 창작이다.

records.name: 박영규
records.design: Long refined face, fine moustache and pointed goatee retained. Mature regional commander and noble: compact black cloth military cap, high folded crown and short tied ends, plum silk outer coat over discreet lamellar chest, bronze clasp at shoulder. Composed diplomatic eyes, upright narrow shoulders. Silhouette distinct from iron-helmeted generals. No Joseon rank badge.
records.appearance: 관모·자주색 겉옷을 갖춘 지역 지휘관
records.referenceNote: 장군과 지역 유력자의 성격을 함께 보이는 창작 복식이다. 개인 착용 기록을 재현한 것은 아니다.

records.name: 복지겸
records.design: Long rectangular face, narrow watchful eyes, neat thin moustache and small beard retained. Disciplined cavalry GENERAL: angular iron helmet with a LOW central ridge and dark green tied tassel, compact leather-lined neck plates, grey metal lamellar shoulders with forest-green lacing. Restrained watchful gaze; helmet unlike Hong Yu dome.
records.appearance: 각진 투구·녹색 끈으로 정돈한 기병 장군
records.referenceNote: 찰갑과 투구 유형을 참고한 창작 군장이다. 녹색은 품계의 고증 표시가 아니다.

records.name: 배현경
records.design: Broad flat nose, broad compact tan face, short horizontal moustache and clean jaw retained. Mounted ARCHER: close-fitting low leather-and-iron skull helmet, open ears and no large crest; slate-green fitted collar, compact shoulder armor, clear SHORT QUIVER with three white-fletched arrows rising behind one shoulder. Sturdy but mobile shoulders. Quiver visible without covering face.
records.appearance: 작은 투구·화살통을 갖춘 궁기병
records.referenceNote: 궁기병은 유지하는 게임 병과다. 화살통과 간결한 보호구는 게임 역할 표현이며 실제 전용 병과의 단정이 아니다.

records.name: 박수경
records.design: Lean youthful clean-shaven diamond face retained. Specialist ARCHER: narrow ochre wrapped headband with neat tied-back hair, NOT metal helmet, dark olive fitted padded archer coat with small leather shoulder protection, distinctive bowstring diagonal and short quiver with three dark-feathered arrows behind shoulder. Focused eyes and lean trained neck. Headband and quiver read clearly at thumbnail size.
records.appearance: 두건·화살통·가벼운 군장의 궁수
records.referenceNote: 궁병은 유지하는 게임 병과다. 실제 인물이 이 모습으로 활을 쏘았다는 복원은 아니다.

records.name: 박술희
records.design: Round-square massive face, wide nose, unruly black-and-gray full beard and crooked smile retained. Experienced close-combat guard/general represented in game as club infantry: dark brown folded cloth war cap, heavy ochre quilted padded coat with broad black leather shoulder straps and red knot, thick neck. Robust cloth and leather, NOT ornate plate armor; no common soldier uniform.
records.appearance: 두툼한 천옷·가죽띠의 근접 호위 장수
records.referenceNote: 원본 적병 역할을 표현한 창작 군복이다. 실제 인물을 산적이나 하급 병졸로 설명하지 않는다.

records.name: 신숭겸
records.design: Broad square face and dense short beard, protective warm eyes retained. Loyal martial GENERAL with game martial-artist role: broad layered burgundy headwrap over high tied hair, dignified dark red military overrobe with ivory crossed inner collar and dark leather shoulder binding, powerful neck and broad shoulders. No metal armor, no helmet. Rich structured martial cloth makes him a commander rather than a peasant.
records.appearance: 붉은 머리띠·넓은 군포의 무장
records.referenceNote: 실제 장군의 위엄과 게임 무도가 역할을 조합한 창작이다. 금속 갑옷 없는 모습은 역사적 복식 확정이 아니다.

records.name: 장영실
records.design: Friendly older round face, short moustache and chin beard retained. Joseon royal ENGINEER appearing as a fantasy guest: practical ochre folded work cap with tied cloth sides, indigo work robe with tan leather apron shoulder straps, a small wooden ruler and bronze divider tucked at breast edge. Inquisitive slightly smiling eyes, average build. Not a military general, no crown, no armor, no modern goggles. Exact work costume is fictional.
records.appearance: 작업모·앞치마·측정 도구의 기술자
records.referenceNote: 조선 세종대 기술자를 후삼국에 배치한 판타지 인물이다. 도구와 작업 복식은 창작이며 당대 초상의 복원이 아니다.

records.name: 최응
records.design: Young clean-shaven fine oval face, intelligent calm eyes and slender neck retained. Civil adviser in FORMAL OFFICIAL ROBE: black early-Goryeo-inspired BOKDU with compact folded top and SHORT side ties, deep muted crimson round-neck official robe with ivory inner collar. Unarmored narrow shoulders. No Joseon embroidered rank square, no long Song wings. Distinct court scholar silhouette.
records.appearance: 검은 관모·붉은 관복의 문신
records.referenceNote: 복두·관복 전통을 참고했다. 관모 각은 썸네일 가독성을 위해 단순화했고 색상은 정확한 품계 복원이 아니다.

records.name: 최지몽
records.design: Long fine-boned youthful face, high forehead, thoughtful narrow eyes, clean-shaven retained. Astronomical court ADVISER: tall soft dark charcoal folded scholar cap, dark teal layered robe with pale blue crossed collar and a tiny bronze circular astronomical clasp. Slender sloping shoulders. No wizard pointed hat, no supernatural glow, no martial armor. Cloth cap distinct from Choe Eung bokdu.
records.appearance: 접은 관모·청록색 겉옷의 천문 조언자
records.referenceNote: 학자 복식 모티프와 게임 도사 역할을 조합했다. 별을 연상시키는 장식과 관모 세부는 창작이다.

records.name: 견훤
records.design: Powerful older rectangular face, thick salt-and-pepper beard, deep forehead lines retained. Rival warrior KING: dark iron-and-gold low royal military crown with three short broad upright ornaments, deep oxblood silk mantle over black lamellar shoulders and wide bronze-gold border. Fierce authoritative eyes, massive neck. Crown low and martial, entirely different from Wang Geon tall cylindrical gold crown. Invented Later Baekje design, not claimed excavated crown.
records.appearance: 낮은 금장 관·붉은 군왕 예복
records.referenceNote: 후백제 군주의 군사적 위엄을 표현한 창작이다. 출토된 견훤의 관을 복원한 것이 아니다.

source.title: 복식 유형 참고 — 실제 개인 관모의 근거가 아님

records.name: 신검
records.design: Narrow youthful heart-shaped face, pale clean-shaven sharp chin and proud expression retained. Ambitious royal successor: slim black-gold formal coronet with two short upright leaf-shaped tips, dark plum noble robe and discreet gold-edged dark shoulder armor, ivory collar. Elegant rather than bulky, not duplicate father crown or Wang Geon crown. Costume fictional Later Baekje royal interpretation.
records.appearance: 작은 금장 관·자주색 왕족 복식
records.referenceNote: 후백제 왕족의 이미지와 젊고 날카로운 인상을 조합했다. 관·색상·용모는 창작이다.

source.title: 복식 유형 참고 — 실제 개인 관모의 근거가 아님

records.name: 궁예
records.design: Shaved head, elongated mature face, one healed closed eye and piercing other eye retained. Buddhist-associated sovereign: BARE BALD HEAD, broad ochre ceremonial sash crossing charcoal-black robe, a restrained strand of dark wooden beads at chest and bronze round clasp. Sinewy strong neck and commanding severe presence. No armor, no TV actor likeness, no modern eyepatch. Religiously inspired creative costume, not verified portrait.
records.appearance: 삭발·황토색 가사풍 장식의 군주
records.referenceNote: 불교적 군주 이미지를 반영한 창작 복식이다. 후대 드라마 배우나 현존 진영의 실제 용모 복원이 아니다.

source.title: 복식 유형 참고 — 실제 개인 관모의 근거가 아님

records.name: 경순왕
records.design: Refined clean-shaven small oval young royal face, worried thoughtful eyes retained. Last Silla KING: modest narrow gold openwork crown with a few delicate tree-branch uprights inspired by earlier Silla crowns, deep blue-violet silk royal robe, ivory inner collar, restrained gold trim. Slim shoulders and solemn noble dignity. Not a huge Christmas-tree crown; acknowledge earlier-period motif not exact tenth-century reconstruction.
records.appearance: 신라 금관 모티프·보랏빛 예복
records.referenceNote: 5~6세기 신라 금관의 세움 장식에서 영감을 얻었다. 10세기 경순왕의 실제 착용 관이라는 뜻은 아니다.

records.name: 왕륭
records.design: Older gentle broad face, gray eyebrows and long narrow salt-and-pepper beard retained. Wealthy regional patriarch and merchant leader: rounded dark brown cloth cap with folded rim, fine warm brown silk outer robe with cream collar and restrained woven geometric edge, one jade fastener. Relaxed average shoulders, perceptive warm eyes. No armor, no royal crown, no poor peasant ragged clothing.
records.appearance: 갈색 관모·고운 겉옷의 호족 가문 어른
records.referenceNote: 지역 유력자의 인상을 표현한 창작이다. 관모·옷·수염은 실제 개인 용모나 복식 기록을 복원한 것이 아니다.

records.name: 윤무
records.design: Adult Korean woman cavalry spear commander about 38. Broad angular face, strong straight eyebrows, sun-weathered warm skin, firm focused expression, athletic thick neck and strong shoulders. Open-faced low iron lamellar helmet with short burgundy plume and visible face, dark iron and brown leather lamellar cuirass, burgundy shoulder cord. Powerful practical frontline officer, not glamorous princess. Three-quarter facing right.
records.appearance: 창 기병 여장부 · 넓은 얼굴과 강한 눈매, 개방형 투구·찰갑
records.referenceNote: 후삼국 역사 판타지를 위한 창작 여성 장수 초안. 인물·성별·용모·군장은 역사 기록의 복원이 아니다. 원본 인물의 혈연과 일대기를 계승하지 않는다.

records.name: 연진
records.design: Adult Korean woman mounted archer about 27. Narrow oval face with high cheekbones, alert slender eyes, subtly asymmetric eyebrow, clean unscarred face, lean athletic shoulders. Black hair tightly braided and tied up with narrow indigo headband, no helmet. Muted teal padded military tunic under light brown leather lamellar vest, practical ivory collar. Quiver feather tips and the curved upper limb of a Korean-inspired composite bow visible beside shoulder. Calm precise marksman, no makeup. Three-quarter facing left. Visually distinct from broad helmeted spear commander.
records.appearance: 여성 궁기병 · 날렵한 얼굴과 묶은 머리, 활·화살통
records.referenceNote: 후삼국 역사 판타지를 위한 창작 여성 장수 초안. 인물·성별·용모·군장은 역사 기록의 복원이 아니다. 원본 인물의 혈연과 일대기를 계승하지 않는다.

records.design: 24-year-old male, round youthful face, clean shaven, straight thin eyebrows, fair skin, composed proud expression. Short black folded cloth cap, plum silk collar over light russet leather armor, slim shoulders; bow upper limb and tidy quiver behind right shoulder.
records.appearance: 24세의 둥근 얼굴·수염 없는 귀족 궁기병
